patterns_en: How many continents are there on Earth?
What are the major oceans of the world?
Which is the largest continent?
patterns_rw: Ni imigabane ingahe iri ku Isi?
Ni izihe nyanja nini ziri ku Isi?
Ni uwuhe mugabane munini kurusha yose?
answer_rw:
Isi igizwe n'imigabane irindwi n'inyanja eshanu nini. Imigabane ni Afrika, Aziya, Amerika y'Amajyaruguru, Amerika y'Epfo, Antagitika, Uburayi, na Ositaraliya. Inyanja nini ni Inyanja y'Amahoro, Inyanja ya Atalantika, Inyanja y'Abahinde, Inyanja y'Amajyaruguru, n'Inyanja y'Epfo.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
The Earth is divided into seven continents and five major oceans. The continents are Africa, Asia, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia. The major oceans are the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Arctic, and Southern Oceans.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What are the major climate types on Earth?
How do ecosystems adapt to specific climates?
What causes variations in world climates?
patterns_rw: Ni ubuhe bwoko bw'ikirere buzwi cyane ku Isi?
Ese ibinyabuzima byagenewe bite ubwoko bw'ikirere?
Ni iki gitera gutandukana kw'ibirere ku Isi?
answer_rw:
Isi igizwe n'ubwoko bw'ikirere butandukanye nk'ishyamba ry'imvura, ubutayu, na savana, buri kimwe gifite ibinyabuzima byacyo bwite bijyanye n'ubushyuhe n'imvura bihaho. Ibi bidukikije bifasha mu kurengera ubuzima bw'Isi.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
The Earth features diverse climate types such as rainforests, deserts, and savannas, each supporting unique life forms adapted to specific temperature and precipitation patterns. These ecosystems sustain global life.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

intents.label_en: Major Language Families of the World
patterns_en: What is the largest language family in the world?
Which languages belong to the Niger-Congo family?
What defines a language family?
patterns_rw: Ni uwuhe muryango w'indimi munini ku isi?
Umuryango wa Niger-Congo ugaragaramo izihe ndimi?
Imiryango y'indimi isobanura iki?
answer_rw:
Imiryango y'indimi z'isi ni amatsinda y'indimi zikomoka ku rurimi rumwe rw'ibanze. Umuryango munini kurusha yose ni uwa Indo-Uburengerazuba n'Uburayi, mu gihe Niger-Congo irimo indimi nyinshi zo muri Afurika yo munsi ya Sahara harimo n'Ikinyarwanda.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
World language families are groups of languages that share a common ancestral origin. The largest family by number of native speakers is Indo-European, while the Niger-Congo family contains the majority of languages spoken in Sub-Saharan Africa, including Kinyarwanda.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: Why is the Earth divided into different time zones?
How many major time zones are there on Earth?
Where does the starting point for global time originate?
patterns_rw: Kuki isi igabanyijemo imibibi y'igihe itandukanye?
Imibibi y'igihe ku isi ni ingahe?
Ni heheho isoko y'igihe cy'isi itangirira?
answer_rw:
Isi igabanyijemo imibibi y'igihe 24 bitewe n'aho igeze mu kuzunguruka kwayo ku zuba. Ibi bifasha abaturage ku isi hose guhuza amasaha agendanye n'umunsi n'ijoro. Umurongo w'isoko y'igihe utangirira i Greenwich mu Bwongereza.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
The Earth is divided into 24 major time zones based on its rotation relative to the sun. This system helps people worldwide coordinate their daily schedules with day and night. The prime meridian for universal time starts in Greenwich, England.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What is crop rotation in agriculture?
What are the benefits of practicing crop rotation?
How does this method help control pests?
patterns_rw: Guhinduranya imbuto bisobanura iki mu buhinzi?
Ni izihe nyungu zo guhinduranya imbuto mu murima?
Ubu buryo bufasha gute mu kurwanya udukoko?
answer_rw:
Guhinduranya imbuto ni uburyo bwo gutera ubwoko butandukanye bw'ibihingwa mu murima umwe uko ibihe bihunze. Bifasha mu kongera intungamubiri mu butaka, kurwanya udukoko n'indwara, no kongera umusaruro w'ubuhinzi.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Crop rotation is the practice of growing different types of crops in the same area across sequential seasons. It helps improve soil fertility, manage pests and diseases, and increase overall agricultural productivity.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: Why is organic fertilizer good for the soil?
What materials are needed to make compost?
How does composting help farmers?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gituma ifumbire y'imborera ari nziza ku butaka?
Ni ibiki bikenewe mu gukora ifumbire y'imborera?
Ese ifumbire y'imborera ifasha mu ki abahinzi?
answer_rw:
Ifumbire y'imborera ikoreshwa mu kongera intungamubiri mu butaka. Ikorwa mu bisigazwa by'ibimera n'amatungo. Ifasha abahinzi kubona umusaruro mwiza kandi yoroshye kuyitegura.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Composting improves soil nutrients using plant and animal waste. It helps farmers increase crop yields and is usually easy to prepare locally.

patterns_en: What are the common irrigation methods?
Why is irrigation important?
How is water delivered to crops?
patterns_rw: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kuhira bukoreshwa cyane?
Kuki kuhira imirima ari ingenzi?
Ni gute amazi agezwa ku bihingwa?
answer_rw:
Uburyo bwo kuhira imirima bufasha abahinzi guha ibihingwa amazi ahagije mu gihe cy'amapfa. Hari uburyo bwinshi nko kunyunyiza amazi cyangwa kuyayobora mu mirongo. Ibi bituma umusaruro wiyongera.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Irrigation methods help farmers provide sufficient water to crops during dry periods. There are various techniques such as sprinkler and furrow irrigation. These methods help increase agricultural yields.

patterns_en: How do you select good seeds?
Where is the best place to store seeds?
Why do seeds need proper care?
patterns_rw: Ni gute wahitamo imbuto nziza?
Ni he hantu heza ho kubika imbuto?
Kuki imbuto zikeneye kwitabwaho?
answer_rw:
Guhitamo imbuto nziza ni ngombwa mu buhinzi. Abahinzi bagomba guhitamo imbuto zifite ubuziranenge kandi zitanduye indwara. Kubika imbuto neza mu hantu humye kandi hakonje bituma zitangirika kandi zigera mu gihe cy'ihinga ziri nzima.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Selecting good seeds is essential in agriculture. Farmers should choose high-quality and disease-free seeds. Storing seeds properly in a dry and cool place prevents damage and ensures they remain viable for the planting season.

patterns_en: What causes soil erosion in Rwanda?
How can soil erosion be prevented?
What are the impacts of soil erosion on agriculture?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gitera isuri mu Rwanda?
Ni gute isuri yafatanywa mu kurwanywa?
Ingaruka z'isuri ku buhinzi ni izihe?
answer_rw:
Isuri ni ikibazo cyugarije ubutaka bw'u Rwanda bitewe n'imisozi miremire n'imvura nyinshi. Ibi bitwara intungamubiri z'ubutaka bigateza n'inkangu. Leta n'abaturage bashyiraho ingamba nko gukora terrase na gahunda yo gutera ibiti kugira ngo barinde ubutaka bwabo.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Soil erosion is a major environmental challenge in Rwanda due to the country's steep topography and heavy rainfall. It removes vital soil nutrients and causes landslides. The government and citizens implement measures like radical terraces and tree planting initiatives to protect agricultural land and prevent environmental degradation.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: How is waste managed in Rwanda?
Are all plastics banned in Rwanda?
What can be done to protect the environment?
patterns_rw: Ni gute imyanda icungwa mu Rwanda?
Ese amaplastiki yose arabujijwe mu Rwanda?
Ni iki cyakorwa kugira ngo ibidukikije birindwe?
answer_rw:
Gucunga imyanda mu Rwanda ni gahunda y'ingenzi yo kubungabunga ibidukikije. Leta y'u Rwanda yashyizeho amategeko abuzanya amplastike akoreshwa rimwe gusa. Hari ibigo bishinzwe gutondeka no gutunganya imyanda kugira ngo hatagira ingaruka mbi ku buzima bw'abaturage.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Waste management in Rwanda is an essential practice for environmental protection. The government of Rwanda has established laws banning single-use plastics. There are designated institutions responsible for sorting and processing waste to prevent negative impacts on public health.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What contributes to Rwanda's biodiversity?
Which national parks have the most wildlife in Rwanda?
How can we protect biodiversity?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gitera urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima mu Rwanda?
Ni izihe pariki zibamo inyamaswa nyinshi mu Rwanda?
Ni gute twarinda urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima?
answer_rw:
u Rwanda rufite urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rutandukanye cyane. Harimo amashyamba yo mu misozi miremire, pariki z'igihugu, n'ibyanya bikomewe. Ibi byose bitanga ubuzima ku bwoko bwinshi bw'inyamaswa n'ibimera. Ibikorwa by'abantu n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere biri mu bishobora gushyira ubwo buzima mu kaga.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Rwanda has a diverse range of biological life. This includes montane forests, national parks, and protected reserves. These areas support many species of animals and plants. Human activities and climate change pose threats to this environment.

patterns_en: What causes air pollution?
What are the effects of air pollution?
How can we prevent air pollution?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gitera umwanda wo mu kirere?
Umwanda wo mu kirere ugira ingaruka izihe?
Ni gute twakumira umwanda wo mu kirere?
answer_rw:
Umwanda wo mu kirere ni igihe ibintu bihumanya ikirere byangiza ubuzima bw'abantu n'ibidukikije. Ibyo bintu birimo imyotsi y'imodoka n'inganda. Mu Rwanda, ubuyobozi bushyiraho ingamba zo kugabanya uwo mwanda kugira ngo abaturage bagire ubuzima bwiza.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Air pollution occurs when harmful substances damage the atmosphere, negatively affecting human health and the environment. Major sources include vehicle emissions and industrial smoke. In Rwanda, authorities implement measures to reduce air pollution to ensure public well-being.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What materials were used in traditional architecture?
What did the King's palace look like?
How was the ingenuity of ancestors demonstrated?
patterns_rw: Ni ibikoresho iki byakoreshwaga mu bwubatsi gakondo?
Inzu y'Umwami yari imeze ite?
Ubuhanga bw'abakurambere bwagaragaraga mu iki?
answer_rw:
Ubwubatsi gakondo bw'Abanyarwanda bwafataga ibiti, ibyatsi n'ibyondo mu kubaka inzu z'umwirongi n'ibwami. Inzu y'Umwami yari nini cyane kandi ikozwe mu byatsi. Ibi byagaragaza ubuhanga bw'abakurambere mu gukoresha ibintu biboneka mu bidukikije.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Traditional Rwandan architecture utilized poles, grass, and clay to build dome-shaped houses and royal compounds. The King's palace was particularly large and constructed entirely from thatch and wood. This demonstrates the ingenuity of ancestors in utilizing local materials.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What are Ibyivugo in Rwandan culture?
When do people recite Ibyivugo?
What is the purpose of oral literature?
patterns_rw: Ibyivugo ni iki mu muco nyarwanda?
Ni ry telefone abantu babyivuga?
Ubuvanganzo bwo mu kanwa bumaze iki?
answer_rw:
Ubuvanganzo bwo mu kanwa ni ingenzi cyane mu muco nyarwanda. Ibyivugo ni ubwoko bw'ubuvanganzo buvuga ibigwi n'amateka y'umuntu cyangwa y'umuryango. Abantu babyivuga mu birori no mu gihe cy'intambara kugira ngo berekane ubutwari n'ishyaka.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Oral literature is very important in Rwandan culture. Ibyivugo are a form of poetry praising the achievements and history of a person or a lineage. People recite them during ceremonies and in times of war to demonstrate bravery and pride.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What is the inanga in Rwandan culture?
What characterizes inanga music?
What is the purpose of the inanga?
patterns_rw: Inanga ni iki mu muco nyarwanda?
Ni iki kiranga imiririmbire y'inanga?
Inanga ikoreshwa mu ki?
answer_rw:
Inanga ni umurinzi w'umuco n'umuziki gakondo w'u Rwanda. Ni igicurangisho cy'umuzika gifite imigozi ivuza amajwi yihariye. Abacuranzi b'inanga bacuranga baririmba amateka, imigani, n'ubuzima bw'Abanyarwanda kuva kera. Ubu buryo bufasha mu kubungabunga umurage w'igihugu.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
The inanga is a traditional trough zither and a cornerstone of Rwandan musical heritage. Musicians pluck its strings while chanting historical tales, folklore, and poetry about Rwandan life. This musical tradition plays a vital role in preserving cultural history.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What characterizes hospitality in Rwanda?
Why is sharing important in Rwandan culture?
What does humanity mean in Rwandan tradition?
patterns_rw: Ni iki kiranga umuco wo kwakira abashyitsi mu Rwanda?
Kuki gusangira bifite agaciro mu Rwanda?
Ubumuntu busobanura iki mu muco nyarwanda?
answer_rw:
Umuco wo kwakira abashyitsi mu Rwanda ni ingenzi cyane. Abashyitsi bahabwa ikaze n'icyubahiro. Gushyikirana no gusangira ni ibimenyetso by'ubumuntu n'ubucuti mu muryango nyarwanda.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Hospitality is a very important part of Rwandan culture. Visitors are welcomed with respect and warmth. Sharing food and conversation are traditional signs of humanity and friendship.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What is the importance of budgeting?
How can you create a personal budget?
How do you avoid unnecessary debt?
patterns_rw: Ni iki cyiza cyo gucunga umutungo?
Wategura ute ingengo y'imari yawe?
Ni gute wakwirinda imyenda idakenewe?
answer_rw:
Gucunga umutungo ni uburyo bwo gutegura uko amafaranga azakoreshwa mu gihe kizaza. Bifasha umuntu kumenya aho amafaranga ava n'aho ajya. Gutegura ingengo y'imari bituma umuntu abasha kwizigamira no kwirinda imyenda idakenewe.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Budgeting is the process of creating a plan to spend and save money. It helps individuals track their income and expenses. Effective financial planning enables people to build savings and avoid unnecessary debt.

patterns_en: What is debt?
How is debt repaid?
What are the consequences of bad debt?
patterns_rw: Umwenda ni iki?
Ni gute umwenda wishyurwa?
Ni izihe ngaruka z'umwenda mubi?
answer_rw:
Umwenda ni amafaranga umuntu cyangwa ikigo gifata kuwundi muntu cyangwa banki, akaba agomba kwishyurwa hamwe n'inyungu. Kwishyura umwenda ku gihe bifasha kubaka amateka meza y'imari bikorohereza umuntukongera gufata inguzanyo mu gihe kizaza. Gicungwa nabi, umwenda ushobora guteza ibibazo bikomeye by'ubukungu.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Debt is money borrowed from a lender, usually a bank, that must be repaid with interest. Repaying debt on time helps build a good credit history and makes it easier to borrow in the future. Mismanaged debt can lead to severe financial difficulties.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What are the basic services provided by a bank?
How can I open a bank account?
What is a bank loan used for?
patterns_rw: Ni izihe serivisi z'ibanze zitangwa na banki?
Twafungura dute konti muri banki?
Inguzanyo ya banki ikoreshwa mu ki?
answer_rw:
Serivisi za banki ni ibikorwa byose banki itanga bifasha abantu n'ibigo kubika amafaranga, kuyohereza, no gufata inguzanyo. Zirimo konti zo kubikamo no gusohora amafaranga, kwishyura fagitire, no gutanga inguzanyo zo guteza imbere ubucuruzi cyangwa imishinga y'abaturage.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Banking services are financial activities provided by banks to help individuals and institutions save money, transfer funds, and borrow. They typically include savings and checking accounts, bill payments, and loans to support business growth and personal projects.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What is insurance?
What are the types of insurance available?
Why is insurance important?
patterns_rw: Ubishingizi ni iki?
Ni izihe nzego z'ubwishingizi zihari?
Kuki ubwishingizi ari ingenzi?
answer_rw:
Ubwishingizi ni amasezerano aho umuntu cyangwa ikigo bishyura amafaranga ku kigo cy'ubwishingizi, maze icyo kigo kikishyura ibyangiritse mu bihe by'ibyago. Bitanga umutekano w'umutungo n'abantu. Hari ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima, ubw'imodoka, ndetse n'ubw'imitungo itandukanye.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Insurance is a contract where an individual or organization pays a fee to an insurance company, which then covers losses during unexpected events. It provides financial security for assets and people. Common types include health, motor vehicle, and property insurance.

knowledge.summary_en: Air pollution occurs when harmful substances damage the atmosphere, negatively affecting human health and the environment. Major sources include vehicle emissions and industrial smoke. In Rwanda, authorities implement measures to reduce air pollution to ensure public well-being.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwubatsi gakondo bw'Abanyarwanda bwafataga ibiti, ibyatsi n'ibyondo mu kubaka inzu z'umwirongi n'ibwami. Inzu y'Umwami yari nini cyane kandi ikozwe mu byatsi. Ibi byagaragaza ubuhanga bw'abakurambere mu gukoresha ibintu biboneka mu bidukikije.
knowledge.summary_en: Traditional Rwandan architecture utilized poles, grass, and clay to build dome-shaped houses and royal compounds. The King's palace was particularly large and constructed entirely from thatch and wood. This demonstrates the ingenuity of ancestors in utilizing local materials.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubuvanganzo bwo mu kanwa ni ingenzi cyane mu muco nyarwanda. Ibyivugo ni ubwoko bw'ubuvanganzo buvuga ibigwi n'amateka y'umuntu cyangwa y'umuryango. Abantu babyivuga mu birori no mu gihe cy'intambara kugira ngo berekane ubutwari n'ishyaka.
knowledge.summary_en: Oral literature is very important in Rwandan culture. Ibyivugo are a form of poetry praising the achievements and history of a person or a lineage. People recite them during ceremonies and in times of war to demonstrate bravery and pride.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inanga ni umurinzi w'umuco n'umuziki gakondo w'u Rwanda. Ni igicurangisho cy'umuzika gifite imigozi ivuza amajwi yihariye. Abacuranzi b'inanga bacuranga baririmba amateka, imigani, n'ubuzima bw'Abanyarwanda kuva kera. Ubu buryo bufasha mu kubungabunga umurage w'igihugu.
knowledge.summary_en: The inanga is a traditional trough zither and a cornerstone of Rwandan musical heritage. Musicians pluck its strings while chanting historical tales, folklore, and poetry about Rwandan life. This musical tradition plays a vital role in preserving cultural history.

knowledge.title_rw: Umuco wo Kwakira Abashyitsi mu Rwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: Umuco wo kwakira abashyitsi mu Rwanda ni ingenzi cyane. Abashyitsi bahabwa ikaze n'icyubahiro. Gushyikirana no gusangira ni ibimenyetso by'ubumuntu n'ubucuti mu muryango nyarwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: Hospitality is a very important part of Rwandan culture. Visitors are welcomed with respect and warmth. Sharing food and conversation are traditional signs of humanity and friendship.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gucunga umutungo ni uburyo bwo gutegura uko amafaranga azakoreshwa mu gihe kizaza. Bifasha umuntu kumenya aho amafaranga ava n'aho ajya. Gutegura ingengo y'imari bituma umuntu abasha kwizigamira no kwirinda imyenda idakenewe.
knowledge.summary_en: Budgeting is the process of creating a plan to spend and save money. It helps individuals track their income and expenses. Effective financial planning enables people to build savings and avoid unnecessary debt.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umwenda ni amafaranga umuntu cyangwa ikigo gifata kuwundi muntu cyangwa banki, akaba agomba kwishyurwa hamwe n'inyungu. Kwishyura umwenda ku gihe bifasha kubaka amateka meza y'imari bikorohereza umuntukongera gufata inguzanyo mu gihe kizaza. Gicungwa nabi, umwenda ushobora guteza ibibazo bikomeye by'ubukungu.
knowledge.summary_en: Debt is money borrowed from a lender, usually a bank, that must be repaid with interest. Repaying debt on time helps build a good credit history and makes it easier to borrow in the future. Mismanaged debt can lead to severe financial difficulties.

knowledge.summary_rw: Serivisi za banki ni ibikorwa byose banki itanga bifasha abantu n'ibigo kubika amafaranga, kuyohereza, no gufata inguzanyo. Zirimo konti zo kubikamo no gusohora amafaranga, kwishyura fagitire, no gutanga inguzanyo zo guteza imbere ubucuruzi cyangwa imishinga y'abaturage.
knowledge.summary_en: Banking services are financial activities provided by banks to help individuals and institutions save money, transfer funds, and borrow. They typically include savings and checking accounts, bill payments, and loans to support business growth and personal projects.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwishingizi ni amasezerano aho umuntu cyangwa ikigo bishyura amafaranga ku kigo cy'ubwishingizi, maze icyo kigo kikishyura ibyangiritse mu bihe by'ibyago. Bitanga umutekano w'umutungo n'abantu. Hari ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima, ubw'imodoka, ndetse n'ubw'imitungo itandukanye.
knowledge.summary_en: Insurance is a contract where an individual or organization pays a fee to an insurance company, which then covers losses during unexpected events. It provides financial security for assets and people. Common types include health, motor vehicle, and property insurance.
